content.short: Bitpay provides buy, store, swap and spend cryptocurrency in one app.
content.description: Founded in 2011, Bitpay is a bitcoin payment service provider headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It enables merchants to accept bitcoin as payment and provides users with access to BTC and BCH. The Bitpay app lets you swap, store, spend, and buy cryptocurrency while earning rewards automatically. It also enables you to use your crypto anywhere Mastercard is accepted, extending crypto payments to everyday purchases.
content.meta: Bitpay enables users to buy, store, swap and spend cryptocurrency in one app. Discover Bitpay and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
